title: Influence-as-a-service
review_note: R2 2026-11-13: verdict unchanged (in), on an explicit human ruling. The source describes one Claude orchestrator deciding per-post actions for 100+ social-media bot personas and does not say the personas are themselves AI agents. Same stance the instance repository already takes for I27 Emergent Goals.
